analysis.title: GS - Kamshad - TMT Today - 27 Oct 2026
key_insights: Futures are up slightly (Nasdaq +35bps, S&P +25bps) with crude and rates slightly lower, ahead of a busy three-day stretch of issuance, the FOMC and large-cap tech earnings. Overnight macro news was quiet apart from a headline that Iran's Supreme Leader called for meeting conditions to end the war.

Global AI stocks are bid. Korea closed +3%, Japan +2%, DRAM +2.5% and SMH +1% in pre-market. Pre-market moves suggest the AI-at-risk universe (software broadly lower) could come under pressure again while AI winners find their footing.

CLS beat and raised. 3Q26 EBIAT was $496mn (8.5% margin) vs GS/consensus of $450mn/$451mn, on revenue of $5.83bn, offset by a gross margin miss at 11.2%. 4Q26 revenue beat the midpoint by $430mn and 2026E revenue guidance was raised by $500mn, more than the beat. Stock +15-16% in pre-market.

CLS initial 2027E guidance beat: revenue of $40.0bn (GS/consensus $39.0bn/$34.9bn), EBIAT margin 9.0% (GS/consensus 8.7%/8.6%), EPS $21.50 (GS/consensus $20.83/$19.24). Capex guided to $1.5-2.0bn, which GS estimates implies breakeven FCF. 2026 FCF guidance was cut to $460mn from $600mn.

CLS announced a 2.5% of public float NCIB (the TSX equivalent of a buyback authorization). GS will look at the call and investor day for 2027 upside, implications for capex and capital raising, early 2028E expectations and the 2027E EBIAT-to-EPS bridge.

CDNS reported in-line results with 2026 guidance raised. Revenue was $1.63bn (GS and Street $1.62bn), non-GAAP EPS $2.11 vs $2.05, and backlog $8.2bn (from $8.1bn). Organic recurring revenue grew about 18% y/y. Stock +2% in pre-market.

CDNS raised 2026 guidance. Revenue midpoint is $6.402bn (prior $6.26-6.34bn, includes Hexagon, which closed Feb. 23) vs GS $6.38bn and Street $6.33bn. EPS midpoint is $8.40 (prior $8.05-8.15) vs GS $8.20 and Street $8.16. Operating margin midpoint is 44.7%.

CDNS introduced a consumption-plus-subscription model for its agent layer while keeping subscriptions for the underlying tools. GS believes agentic tools could drive higher EDA consumption and accelerate revenue growth over time.
GLW rose 2% on solid results, lifting the optical complex (COHR and LITE higher in pre-market).
Commercial Times reports TSMC plans to raise CoWoS prices by up to 20%.

Seoul Economic Daily reports SK Hynix is preparing a 50t-60t won shareholder return plan to be announced Oct. 28, mainly a special dividend, with a buyback also under consideration. SK Hynix recently completed a 40t won buyback.
Intel agreed to acquire Israeli quantum software startup Classiq (price undisclosed, close expected 1H 2027), ahead of Intel's 3Q earnings on Thursday.

GS expects in-line AAPL F4Q26 results: iPhone revenue +15% y/y on price increases and the Duo launch, Services +10% y/y, and gross margin of 47.8% including a 1pp tariff refund benefit and component cost inflation. Price increases should increasingly offset memory and component cost pressure into the December quarter.

GS is Neutral on Amkor (AMKR), expecting the stock to be range bound after a tepid quarter with revenue and EPS guidance below the Street. Smartphone and consumer weakness offset strength in computing and advanced packaging. GS wants evidence of operating leverage, gross margin expansion and better cash flow before turning more constructive.
Street actions: DA Davidson upgraded AVGO to Buy and UBS downgraded HUBS to Neutral.

The week's calendar: FOMC decision Wednesday 10/28 (WIRP 11% chance of a hike), Core PCE and GDP Thursday 10/29 (consensus core PCE +30bps m/m) alongside the ECB and BOJ decisions, and heavy earnings (MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, AMZN, INTC, COIN and others).

market_movers.rationale: Beat and raise on 3Q26, 2026E revenue guidance raised by more than the beat, 2027E guidance well above GS and consensus, and a 2.5% NCIB announced. Stock +15-16% in pre-market.

sector_views.rationale: AI-related stocks are broadly bid, with strength in DRAM, semis and optical (COHR, LITE) on solid earnings from CLS and GLW.
Pre-market moves suggest the AI-at-risk software universe could come under pressure again.

earnings_insights: CLS 3Q26 reported (10/27): EBIAT $496mn (8.5% margin) vs GS $450mn / consensus (Visible Alpha) $451mn. Revenue $5.83bn beat, gross margin 11.2% missed. 2027E guidance: revenue $40.0bn (GS $39.0bn / consensus $34.9bn), EBIAT margin 9.0% (GS 8.7% / consensus 8.6%), EPS $21.50 (GS $20.83 / consensus $19.24).

CDNS 3Q26 reported (10/27): revenue $1.63bn vs GS and Street $1.62bn, non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $2.11 vs GS and Street $2.05, operating margin 44.1% vs $44.2%. IP revenue $245mn vs GS $229mn / Street $235mn. System Design and Analysis revenue $261mn vs GS $271mn / Street $267mn. FY26 guidance midpoint: revenue $6.402bn, EPS $8.40, operating margin 44.7%.
GLW reported solid results on 10/27 (stock +2% in pre-market), driving strength in the optical complex.
AAPL F4Q26 preview (GS estimates, not reported): iPhone revenue +15% y/y, Services +10% y/y, gross margin 47.8% including a 1pp tariff refund benefit. GS expects in-line results.
AMKR reported a tepid quarter with revenue and EPS guidance below the Street. GS is Neutral and expects the stock to be range bound.

Reuters-style expectation from the note: SK Hynix is expected to announce shareholder returns on Oct. 28 and reports earnings overnight Tuesday into Wednesday (post-close 10/27 per the macro section).

Earnings this week: pre-market 10/27 AMT, BA, CNC, FCX, GLW, HCA, ITW, JCI, KO, PCAR, RCL, SHW, SPGI, TRU, UPS. Post-close 10/27 includes STX, V, HOOD, NXPI, TER. Wednesday includes MSFT, GOOGL, NOW, KLAC after close. Thursday includes AMZN, INTC, COIN, RBLX, SBUX after close.
